summary.result: The drought characteristics illustrated by the SPEI results are compared with a Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) results and drought impact information to understand how these indices can explain the drought conditions within the country.
summary.background: North Korea is one of the high vulnerable countries facing the threat of natural disaster and has experienced more frequent disasters in recent years.
summary.method: Characteristics of the extreme drought in North Korea are examined by using the weekly-based Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI).
